recipes.name: Summer Brew
ingredients_raw: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
3 (12 fluid ounce) bottles Mexican beer (such as Corona®)

steps.text: Combine the limeade, beer, and vodka in a pitcher; gently stir. Serve over ice and garnish with lime wedges.

raw_recipe.headline: Summer Brew
raw_recipe.description: Summer brew is a crowd-pleasing refreshing cocktail drink that’s easy to make with vodka, beer, and frozen limeade for those hot summer days.

review.reviewBody: We make a version of Summer Brew, but it is 1 can lemonade, full can of vodka, and 3 beers....yummy in the summer around the pool!

so refreshing!! instead of making a big batch, I just made one drink at a time. filled 24 oz tervis tumbler 1/2 way with crushed ice, poor in 1 bottle of corona light, then equal parts limeade concentrate and vodka to top of cup, then stired. Perfect cure to Florida summer heat!!
We make this as a Strip and Go Naked also, but with whiskey, beer and lemonade concentrate, in a blender with lots of ice, sort of an "adult slushie"

Excellent and refreshing drink for hanging out at the pool! We changed it up tho: 1 can BL Lime, 1 can BL Orange, 1 can Corona Premium and used 1/3 can each of Limeade, Lemonade, and OJ. A little too orangy, but still delicious!

I've been making a version of this for over 20 years with a few slight changes, I eliminate the water from the pink lemonade and only use the concentrate, use a mickey or 13 oz of vodka and 6 beer I use bud light lime to skip the garnish step and still get the lime taste, find it easier to do the shopping and I only have to make it once, we called the mixture "porch crawler", perfect for a hot day!!!
was good used bud light lime instead of corona.
Livng in Florida, I make this to take out on the Boat for our raft-up parties...This is the best! I double the recipe and put in a big pitcher using Bud lite lime beer.
Would give it more stars if I could!! I did add a 1/4 cup triple sec.

This truly is awesome, easy, and delicious! My wife and I drank about 3 pitchers in 5 days. I might top it with a sprig of mint. 

I would try using rum instead of vodka and add a little mint and call it a "Mexican Mojito"

Made this as a signature drink at a couples shower a couple months ago and everyone raved over it. Everyone kept asking me what was in it and despite having a liquor bar and beer, this ran out first and everyone wished there was more. It became the request at bachelorette parties and events the rest of the summer. I used Tecate and it turned out great!

LOVE this drink, but it definitely has the hidden kick that some others mentioned! It's cold weather out but I made spicy food and this goes splendidly with it. I substituted lemon/lime crystal light (but made it concentrated) and it's perfect! Poured it over crushed ice, divine.
It was outstanding! No changes. Will make it again.

Do NOT repeat, do NOT make this in a blender! Beer bubble explosion. D'oh! Had to lick off the countertop. 
Used honey & muddled in a sprig of rosemary.

Made a pitcher of this for our family cookout and it was the perfect choice ... light and refreshing. I followed the recipe exactly (using Dos Equis beer and including the optional vodka). We all really enjoyed it; I wouldn't change a thing.

This has been the go to drink at our cabin for more than 20 years. We do use a whole can of vodka. We have always called it A Slip and go Naked. If you drink more than one that is a definite possibility!
I've made this but with a full can of tequila instead of vodka. It's called a corona-rita! so good!

my personal recipe calls for a full handle of cheap vodka (congress, crystal palace, burnetts, etc), a 30 rack of beer (natty works for this but you can use pretty much anything), and 5 of the frozen juice concentrates you can buy at walmart (any flavour works, they all kinda mesh together). stir it up in a huge bin and you're golden

Yum-tastes like a margarita! I've made it several times for friends and everyone has liked it too. Great that you can make a pitcher and just pour as you want, not single drink after single drink. Great to take to a party, or have for a party. Followed recipe exactly.
Made it with one bottle of Bud Light Lime and 2 bottles of Bud Light Lime Mojito with some fresh mint leaves to garnish. Gave it a minty summer taste. Yummy

Awesome! My new favorite drink! I wouldn't change a thing. I like Margaritas, but can't drink them because of the heavy drink mix and the tequila gives me a headache. This tastes much better than a margarita and is not heavy on the stomach.
